input.transcript: Alice (Davis SDR): Thanks for joining. Bob (FinchPay): Sure. Our main issue is tracing broken dashboards. Alice: We can help there. Bob: OK - send me the security whitepaper by Friday, and let's schedule a technical deep-dive with my staff engineer next week. Alice: Will do, I'll also share pricing. Bob: Great.

action_items: Schedule technical deep-dive with staff engineer next week

input.transcript: Carol (Meridian): Before we proceed our compliance team must review your HIPAA docs. Dan (Davis SDR): I'll send the BAA template today. Carol: Also add my colleague Ravi to the follow-up thread. Dan: Done. Carol: And we'd want a sandbox environment for two weeks.

action_items: Add Ravi to the follow-up thread

input.transcript: Erik (NordCap): We are mid-audit so timing is tight. Fay (Davis SDR): Understood. Erik: Send a one-pager my CFO can read in five minutes. Fay: I'll have it to you tomorrow. Erik: If the CFO approves we'll do a pilot in Q3.

Gina (Velocity): The demo was fine but pricing is unclear. Hal (Davis SDR): I'll send a tiered pricing sheet. Gina: Include the Snowflake connector costs specifically. Hal: Noted. Gina: Nothing else from our side, we'll be in touch.

action_items: Send tiered pricing sheet including Snowflake connector costs

input.transcript: Ivan (VoltBank): Frankly I'm not convinced. Jo (Davis SDR): What would change your mind? Ivan: Show me a bank of our size using this in production. Jo: I'll arrange a reference call with a comparable customer. Ivan: Fine, and route all future email through my assistant, not me.

action_items: Arrange reference call with a comparable bank customer
